paragraphs.source_en: Sakubei's anger flared, and he thrust his spear straight at Mori Ranmaru. Mori Ranmaru fell sprawling onto his back, yet he still used the shaft of his spear to bar Sakubei's advancing feet. Sakubei grew desperate. He wanted both to kill Mori Ranmaru and to finish Nobunaga with a single thrust, then take his head.

units.source_en: Sakubei's anger flared, and he thrust his spear straight at Mori Ranmaru.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫怒上心头，对着森兰丸就是一枪。

units.source_en: Mori Ranmaru fell sprawling onto his back, yet he still used the shaft of his spear to bar Sakubei's advancing feet.
units.source_zh: 森兰丸摔了个四脚朝天，可仍用枪柄阻止着作兵卫前进的双脚。

units.source_en: Sakubei grew desperate. He wanted both to kill Mori Ranmaru and to finish Nobunaga with a single thrust, then take his head.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫急了，他既想杀死森兰丸，又想一枪结果信长的性命，取信长的首级。

paragraphs.source_zh: 作兵卫怒上心头，对着森兰丸就是一枪。森兰丸摔了个四脚朝天，可仍用枪柄阻止着作兵卫前进的双脚。作兵卫急了，他既想杀死森兰丸，又想一枪结果信长的性命，取信长的首级。

paragraphs.source_en: Thus Samanosuke Mitsuharu sternly commanded Yamamoto San'emon, Yasuda Sakubei, and Shiotan Tajima-no-kami: “Bring me Nobunaga's head before daybreak!”

units.source_en: Thus Samanosuke Mitsuharu sternly commanded Yamamoto San'emon, Yasuda Sakubei, and Shiotan Tajima-no-kami: “Bring me Nobunaga's head before daybreak!”
units.source_zh: 于是，左马助光春就严令山本三右卫门、安田作兵卫和四王天但马守三人：“天亮之前，提信长人头来见！”

paragraphs.source_zh: 于是，左马助光春就严令山本三右卫门、安田作兵卫和四王天但马守三人：“天亮之前，提信长人头来见！”

paragraphs.source_en: After great difficulty, Sakubei had broken through the fierce resistance and fought his way this far; Nobunaga was now almost within reach. Though Ranmaru had fallen, he rolled beneath Sakubei's feet and desperately blocked him, refusing to let him advance even half a step.

units.source_en: After great difficulty, Sakubei had broken through the fierce resistance and fought his way this far; Nobunaga was now almost within reach.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫好不容易突破顽强的抵抗，攻到这里，且信长已近在咫尺。

units.source_en: Though Ranmaru had fallen, he rolled beneath Sakubei's feet and desperately blocked him, refusing to let him advance even half a step.
units.source_zh: 兰丸虽已倒地，却滚到他脚下，拼命挡住，不让他前进半步。

paragraphs.source_zh: 作兵卫好不容易突破顽强的抵抗，攻到这里，且信长已近在咫尺。兰丸虽已倒地，却滚到他脚下，拼命挡住，不让他前进半步。

paragraphs.source_en: Sakubei hurriedly tried to scramble up, but Mori Ranmaru, balanced on one leg upon the railing, had already driven his spear at him. The thrust was not especially swift, but because Sakubei was just rising, the long spear entered through a gap in his armor, pierced his left leg, and struck the stone beneath it. At almost the same instant, Sakubei cast aside his spear and swept out the sword at his waist with his right hand.

units.source_en: Sakubei hurriedly tried to scramble up, but Mori Ranmaru, balanced on one leg upon the railing, had already driven his spear at him.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫慌忙想爬起来，单腿站在栏杆上的森兰丸，枪已刺到。

units.source_en: The thrust was not especially swift, but because Sakubei was just rising, the long spear entered through a gap in his armor, pierced his left leg, and struck the stone beneath it.

ja.t: かったわけではない。だが、

units.source_zh: 他的出手也并非特别快，但因为作兵卫刚要起身，长枪从护甲的缝里刺了进去，刺穿了作兵卫的左腿，撞在石头上。

units.source_en: At almost the same instant, Sakubei cast aside his spear and swept out the sword at his waist with his right hand.
units.source_zh: 几在同一瞬间，扔掉长枪的作兵卫，右手已经挥出了腰刀。

paragraphs.source_zh: 作兵卫慌忙想爬起来，单腿站在栏杆上的森兰丸，枪已刺到。他的出手也并非特别快，但因为作兵卫刚要起身，长枪从护甲的缝里刺了进去，刺穿了作兵卫的左腿，撞在石头上。几在同一瞬间，扔掉长枪的作兵卫，右手已经挥出了腰刀。

paragraphs.source_en: “Ugh...” Ranmaru cried out in agony. Sakubei's mighty stroke severed the crosspiece between the spear shaft and the railing, and cut Mori Ranmaru's leg clean off at the knee.

units.source_en: “Ugh...” Ranmaru cried out in agony.
units.source_zh: “呜……”兰丸一声惨叫。

units.source_en: Sakubei's mighty stroke severed the crosspiece between the spear shaft and the railing, and cut Mori Ranmaru's leg clean off at the knee.
units.source_zh: 作兵卫的豪刀砍断了枪柄与栏杆之间的横木，森兰丸的腿被从膝盖处一刀砍断。

paragraphs.source_zh: “呜……”兰丸一声惨叫。作兵卫的豪刀砍断了枪柄与栏杆之间的横木，森兰丸的腿被从膝盖处一刀砍断。

paragraphs.source_en: A fire must have broken out inside. Flames surged against the windows again and again, thrusting out long tongues of fire. Thick, billowing smoke poured from the cracks around the windows and from the roof.

units.source_en: A fire must have broken out inside.
units.source_zh: 里面定是着了火。

units.source_en: Flames surged against the windows again and again, thrusting out long tongues of fire.
units.source_zh: 烈焰一次次扑向窗户，喷出了长长的火舌。

units.source_en: Thick, billowing smoke poured from the cracks around the windows and from the roof.
units.source_zh: 滚滚浓烟从窗缝和屋顶冒了出来。

paragraphs.source_zh: 里面定是着了火。烈焰一次次扑向窗户，喷出了长长的火舌。滚滚浓烟从窗缝和屋顶冒了出来。

paragraphs.source_en: By then, the first dim light of dawn had come, and the surroundings were barely visible. A sharp succession of crackling and bursting sounds rang out, but Lady Nō had already lost all hearing.

units.source_en: By then, the first dim light of dawn had come, and the surroundings were barely visible.

ja.t: み、あたりをかろうじて
せるようになっていた。

units.source_zh: 此时天已蒙蒙亮，勉强能看清四周。

units.source_en: A sharp succession of crackling and bursting sounds rang out, but Lady Nō had already lost all hearing.
units.source_zh: 传来噼里啪啦的爆裂声，可是，浓夫人已听力尽失。

paragraphs.source_zh: 此时天已蒙蒙亮，勉强能看清四周。传来噼里啪啦的爆裂声，可是，浓夫人已听力尽失。

paragraphs.source_en: While Ranmaru and Sakubei were locked in combat, Nobunaga had already taken his own life; to keep the enemy from obtaining his head, he had set the place ablaze and consigned himself to the flames.

units.source_en: While Ranmaru and Sakubei were locked in combat, Nobunaga had already taken his own life; to keep the enemy from obtaining his head, he had set the place ablaze and consigned himself to the flames.
units.source_zh: 在兰丸和作兵卫厮打之时，信长已经自尽，为了不让敌人得到首级，他放火自焚了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 在兰丸和作兵卫厮打之时，信长已经自尽，为了不让敌人得到首级，他放火自焚了。

paragraphs.source_en: Having cut Ranmaru down, Sakubei hastily rose, bound his wounded leg, and tried to charge into the flames. In the blink of an eye, the inner hall had become a sea of fire. Even so, Sakubei repeatedly dodged the dense smoke and kept beating at the flames, trying to force his way inside.

units.source_en: Having cut Ranmaru down, Sakubei hastily rose, bound his wounded leg, and tried to charge into the flames.
units.source_zh: 把兰丸砍倒在地的作兵卫慌忙站起来，扎好腿伤，要冲进烈焰。

units.source_en: In the blink of an eye, the inner hall had become a sea of fire.
units.source_zh: 眨眼间，内殿已经变成了一片火海。

units.source_en: Even so, Sakubei repeatedly dodged the dense smoke and kept beating at the flames, trying to force his way inside.
units.source_zh: 尽管如此，作兵卫仍几次躲开浓烟，不断地抽打着火焰，企图冲进去。

paragraphs.source_zh: 把兰丸砍倒在地的作兵卫慌忙站起来，扎好腿伤，要冲进烈焰。眨眼间，内殿已经变成了一片火海。尽管如此，作兵卫仍几次躲开浓烟，不断地抽打着火焰，企图冲进去。

paragraphs.source_en: It was not Nobunaga's voice, but the trembling voice of the lady's own heart; and yet she believed it was Nobunaga speaking.

units.source_en: It was not Nobunaga's voice, but the trembling voice of the lady's own heart; and yet she believed it was Nobunaga speaking.
units.source_zh: 这不是信长的声音，这是夫人颤抖的心声，可是，夫人却觉得这就是信长的声音。

paragraphs.source_zh: 这不是信长的声音，这是夫人颤抖的心声，可是，夫人却觉得这就是信长的声音。

paragraphs.source_en: With that, Sakubei sheathed his blood-drenched sword, dragged Mori Ranmaru's corpse to a pillar with all his strength, and tried to prop it upright. Perhaps he meant to vent upon Mori Ranmaru all his fury at having failed to take Nobunaga's head.

units.source_en: With that, Sakubei sheathed his blood-drenched sword, dragged Mori Ranmaru's corpse to a pillar with all his strength, and tried to prop it upright.
units.source_zh: 言罢，作兵卫把血淋淋的刀装进刀鞘，使劲把森兰丸的尸体拖到柱子旁边，想让尸体立起来。

units.source_en: Perhaps he meant to vent upon Mori Ranmaru all his fury at having failed to take Nobunaga's head.

ja.t: にぶつけようとしたのだろう。

units.source_zh: 大概他想把没有取到信长首级的愤怒，全都发泄在森兰丸身上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 言罢，作兵卫把血淋淋的刀装进刀鞘，使劲把森兰丸的尸体拖到柱子旁边，想让尸体立起来。大概他想把没有取到信长首级的愤怒，全都发泄在森兰丸身上。

paragraphs.source_en: With no feeling left in her hands or feet, the lady barely managed to turn her head and let her body fall to the right. She had seen the burning hall and the dance of human tragedy; only the headless corpse of Mori Ranmaru did she not wish to see.

units.source_en: With no feeling left in her hands or feet, the lady barely managed to turn her head and let her body fall to the right.
units.source_zh: 手脚一点儿感觉都没有了，夫人勉强扭头，让身体倒向右边。

units.source_en: She had seen the burning hall and the dance of human tragedy; only the headless corpse of Mori Ranmaru did she not wish to see.
units.source_zh: 燃烧的大殿也看见了，人间悲剧的舞蹈也看见了，只有森兰丸那无头的尸体，她不想看。

paragraphs.source_zh: 手脚一点儿感觉都没有了，夫人勉强扭头，让身体倒向右边。燃烧的大殿也看见了，人间悲剧的舞蹈也看见了，只有森兰丸那无头的尸体，她不想看。

paragraphs.source_en: The lady saw that a pale blue dawn had settled all around. The stars overhead had vanished, and across a sky like translucent porcelain, black smoke rolled and billowed, borne into the distance by the southwesterly wind.

units.source_en: The lady saw that a pale blue dawn had settled all around. The stars overhead had vanished, and across a sky like translucent porcelain, black smoke rolled and billowed, borne into the distance by the southwesterly wind.
units.source_zh: 夫人发现，四周已迎来了淡蓝色的黎明，头顶的星星已经消失，像透明瓷器一般的天空中，乌黑的浓烟翻滚，随着西南风飘向远方。

paragraphs.source_zh: 夫人发现，四周已迎来了淡蓝色的黎明，头顶的星星已经消失，像透明瓷器一般的天空中，乌黑的浓烟翻滚，随着西南风飘向远方。

paragraphs.source_en: To the lady, the karmic fire devouring the temple buildings of Honnō-ji before her seemed to have drifted all the way to Azuchi, where it ceaselessly consumed that magnificent castle keep. People, and all the many things people had made, had vanished before anyone knew when. Whoever had brought all this about, everything was held in the hands of the puppeteer at the other end of the strings...

units.source_en: To the lady, the karmic fire devouring the temple buildings of Honnō-ji before her seemed to have drifted all the way to Azuchi, where it ceaselessly consumed that magnificent castle keep.
units.source_zh: 夫人觉得眼前吞噬着本能寺的伽蓝业火，似已飘到了安土，不断地吞噬着那幢华丽的天守阁。

units.source_en: People, and all the many things people had made, had vanished before anyone knew when.

ja.t: したさまざまなものも、いつの

units.source_zh: 人，还有人制造的各种各样的东西，不知何时全都消失了。

units.source_en: Whoever had brought all this about, everything was held in the hands of the puppeteer at the other end of the strings...
units.source_zh: 不知是谁弄出的这一切，都掌控在线一端那个木偶师手中……

paragraphs.source_zh: 夫人觉得眼前吞噬着本能寺的伽蓝业火，似已飘到了安土，不断地吞噬着那幢华丽的天守阁。人，还有人制造的各种各样的东西，不知何时全都消失了。不知是谁弄出的这一切，都掌控在线一端那个木偶师手中……

paragraphs.source_en: Mori Ranmaru must already have yielded that gallant head into Sakubei's hands. No, it was not Sakubei who had taken it; surely that too was the evil wrought by the treacherous puppeteer. And more than that, before long this puppeteer would visit the same tragedy upon Akechi Mitsuhide and Yasuda Sakubei.

units.source_en: Mori Ranmaru must already have yielded that gallant head into Sakubei's hands.

ja.t: してしまったのだろう。

units.source_zh: 森兰丸定已把那潇洒的头颅交到作兵卫手上了。

units.source_en: No, it was not Sakubei who had taken it; surely that too was the evil wrought by the treacherous puppeteer. And more than that, before long this puppeteer would visit the same tragedy upon Akechi Mitsuhide and Yasuda Sakubei.

いなのだ。そればかりか、その

units.source_zh: 不，那不是作兵卫取走的，定也是那心怀不轨的木偶师造的孽，不仅如此，这个木偶师不久后还会让同样的悲剧，降临到明智光秀和安田作兵卫身上。

paragraphs.source_zh: 森兰丸定已把那潇洒的头颅交到作兵卫手上了。不，那不是作兵卫取走的，定也是那心怀不轨的木偶师造的孽，不仅如此，这个木偶师不久后还会让同样的悲剧，降临到明智光秀和安田作兵卫身上。

paragraphs.source_en: At this thought, the corpses strewn haphazardly across the courtyard once more came sharply into her view. Perhaps because the sky was steadily brightening, the green lawn looked like duckweed floating upon water, while the corpses more and more resembled brilliant water lilies.

units.source_en: At this thought, the corpses strewn haphazardly across the courtyard once more came sharply into her view.
units.source_zh: 想到这里，院子里横七竖八的尸体又一次清晰地映入她的眼帘。

units.source_en: Perhaps because the sky was steadily brightening, the green lawn looked like duckweed floating upon water, while the corpses more and more resembled brilliant water lilies.
units.source_zh: 大概是天渐渐亮起来了，绿色的草地看来就像漂在水面的浮萍，那些尸体则越来越像艳丽的睡莲了。

paragraphs.source_zh: 想到这里，院子里横七竖八的尸体又一次清晰地映入她的眼帘。大概是天渐渐亮起来了，绿色的草地看来就像漂在水面的浮萍，那些尸体则越来越像艳丽的睡莲了。

units.source_en: Suddenly, the lady coughed softly.
units.source_zh: 忽然，夫人轻轻地咳嗽了一声。

paragraphs.source_zh: 忽然，夫人轻轻地咳嗽了一声。

paragraphs.source_en: The great fire in the hall spread in every direction, and smoke and flame were blown toward her. As though cursing someone unseen before her, the lady moved her head slightly; then her pale hand clutched the green grass and became still. There still seemed to be living men within the temple, for amid the roaring blaze came, from time to time, the sounds of fighting...

units.source_en: The great fire in the hall spread in every direction, and smoke and flame were blown toward her.
units.source_zh: 大殿的大火四处蔓延，浓烟和火焰被吹向了这边。

units.source_en: As though cursing someone unseen before her, the lady moved her head slightly; then her pale hand clutched the green grass and became still.
units.source_zh: 夫人像在诅咒着眼前看不见的什么人，微微地动了一下头，苍白的手抓着绿草，不动了。

units.source_en: There still seemed to be living men within the temple, for amid the roaring blaze came, from time to time, the sounds of fighting...
units.source_zh: 看来寺内还有活着的人，在熊熊燃烧的烈火中，还不时传来打斗的声音……

paragraphs.source_zh: 大殿的大火四处蔓延，浓烟和火焰被吹向了这边。夫人像在诅咒着眼前看不见的什么人，微微地动了一下头，苍白的手抓着绿草，不动了。看来寺内还有活着的人，在熊熊燃烧的烈火中，还不时传来打斗的声音……

paragraphs.source_en: Overhead, seventy or eighty crows startled into flight by the inferno gathered into a flock and flew northward, cawing harshly.

units.source_en: Overhead, seventy or eighty crows startled into flight by the inferno gathered into a flock and flew northward, cawing harshly.
units.source_zh: 头顶上，被烈火惊飞的乌鸦，七八十只结成一群，呱呱叫着向北方飞去。
